plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Campus · SEU [![CI](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Code license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH 0.2.1-rc.2](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 把东南大学的校园绿、校训、建筑与叮东带进 DSH Web。 一个独立维护的单校校园主题插件，支持九龙湖与四牌楼两种风景，跟随宿主浅色、深色和系统外观。与东南大学及 DeepSeek 官方无隶属或背书关系。 ![浅色主题，开启可选叮东](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/light-mascot.jpg) 截图开启了可选叮东，安装后的默认值为关闭。截图中的摄影与角色素材说明见 [素材来源](ATTRIBUTION.md)。 ## 功能 - **校园氛围**：校园绿与金色点缀、完整校徽、「止于至善」校训、1902 侧栏铭牌，连同宿主菜单一起适配。 - **两种校区风景**：九龙湖李文正图书馆、四牌楼大礼堂；缩略图下拉列表支持键盘导航。 - **可选叮东**：内置透明背景的挥手重建形象，独立开关；支持替换为自己的本地图片，随时恢复内置形象。 - **按需显示**：主题、欢迎卡、校训和叮东均可开关；关闭主题恢复宿主外观。 - **集中设置**：仅使用「设置 → 校园主题(SEU)」入口，位于内置设置项下方。素材来源和署名统一收纳在设置中。 - **响应式布局**：适配浅色、深色、窄窗口、矮窗口及主栏宽度变化，保留宿主输入框与会话交互。
查看深色、窄窗口和设置效果 ![深色主题](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/dark-mascot.jpg) ![主题设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/main/docs/screenshots/v0.3/settings-mascot.jpg)
## 安装 `v0.3.1` 兼容 **DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2`**；仍使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 时，请安装 [v0.3.0](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/releases/tag/v0.3.0)。CLI/TUI 不适用。先确认 `dsh --version`，并将下面的 `YOUR_PROFILE` 替换为你正在使用的 Web profile 名称。 推荐从 [Releases](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/releases) 安装预构建包，无需在用户机器编译： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-campus-seu-0.3.1.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 安装后重新启动该 profile 的 DSH Web 并刷新浏览器，在「设置 → 校园主题(SEU)」中调整。校园主题默认启用，叮东默认关闭。 也可下载 Release 的 `.tgz` 后安装本地文件： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add ./dsh-campus-seu-0.3.1.tgz --ignore-scripts ``` 卸载后同样重新启动 DSH Web： ```sh dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE remove dsh-campus-seu ``` 升级已安装的旧版时，对同一 profile 再次执行上面的 `add` 命令即可替换包；安装后重新启动 DSH Web 并刷新浏览器。 ## 使用与数据 所有设置即时生效。偏好仅保存在当前浏览器的 `dsh-campus-seu.preferences.v1` 中，并在同源标签页间同步；不改写 DSH 自身的外观偏好，不修改对话数据。 自选叮东图片支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP，最大 512 KiB，在当前浏览器中保存，不上传。「恢复内置形象」仅清除自选图片，保留叮东显示开关；「恢复主题默认设置」会清除本插件的偏好，恢复主题启用、九龙湖欢迎卡和校训，关闭叮东。 ## 本地开发 需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` 和 pnpm `10.33.2`。依赖与宿主版本由锁文件固定。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu.git cd dsh-campus-seu pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm run check pnpm run dev ``` `dev` 在本目录 `.runtime/dsh-home` 中创建隔离的 Web profile，默认仅监听 `127.0.0.1:39395`。打开终端输出的本地认证地址即可预览。它不复制现有账号、模型密钥或用户 DSH 配置。 仓库提交预构建的 `lib/client.js`，修改源码后请运行 `pnpm run check` 并同步提交构建产物。CI 会检查构建、自动测试、已提交产物一致性和打包。 生成分发包： ```sh pnpm run check pnpm pack --pack-destination .runtime/dist ``` 分发包只包含插件入口、客户端产物、素材、补丁和必要说明，不含开发实例、认证配置、缓存、截图或用户自选图片。保留 `private: true` 以防意外发布 npm；不影响 GitHub 与 tarball 安装。 ## 兼容性与验证 本版本基于 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2` 的主题 API 与插槽。欢迎卡扩展了 `conversation.hero.brand.mark` 品牌插槽的布局；升级宿主后需重新检查外观。其他插件同时占用该插槽或覆盖相同颜色时，显示受优先级与覆盖顺序影响。 当前自动测试涵盖 DSH 官方兼容性检查、设置持久化、输入校验、素材路由边界及外观清理生命周期。真实 DSH 中的浅色、深色、窄窗口和设置交互记录见 [界面验证记录](https://github.com/xinyang20/dsh-campus-seu/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md)。这些检查不包含模型回答质量或所有第三方插件组合。 ## 开源与素材 **插件代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。图片和品牌素材使用各自的许可或权利说明。** 两张建筑照片分别采用 CC BY-SA 4.0、CC BY-SA 3.0；校徽及叮东角色不因代码开源获得额外授权。内置叮东是 AI 重建形象，不是官方标准图。 完整范围见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)、[素材来源与署名](ATTRIBUTION.md) 和 [叮东生成记录](docs/dingdong-generation.md)。界面截图中出现的素材同样适用这些说明。 仓库使用 `dsh` 和官方约定的 `dsh-plugin` topics。打包遵循 [DSH 插件发布文档](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish)，发现规则见 [DSH README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#community-and-support)。

plugins.description: DSH 审批弹窗 AI 注释器：模型请求权限外操作时，用模型自己的推理解释这次操作的意义与风险
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Approval Explainer English | [中文](README.zh.md) An AI annotator for the approval dialog in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). When the model asks to run something outside your workspace, `dsh` shows an approval prompt. This plugin adds an explanation next to the command, generated from the model's own reasoning: what the code does, what the model is trying to achieve, how risky it is and why, and what each button actually means. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ArisuYuuko/dsh-approval-explainer ``` `desktop` is the profile the desktop app boots. The first use of a profile initializes it. Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**. Reloading the page is not enough: the host half loads only at process start. Verify the layer was installed: ```sh dsh --profile desktop --dump-config ``` ```yaml # == dsh-approval-explainer - id: dsh-approval-explainer name: dsh-approval-explainer inject: - llm - approval ``` This plugin is plain JavaScript with no build step, so pnpm does not ask you to authorize `allowBuilds`. See [Install notes](#install-notes). To remove it, along with its configuration layer: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-approval-explainer ``` ## What it does Without the plugin an approval prompt shows only the command: ``` 即将执行 & '\diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl.ps1' -Path 'D:\some-project' -AllowRewrite ``` You have to work out what it does, what it touches, and what happens if you accept. If you cannot, you are choosing between trusting blindly and refusing blindly. The plugin adds this to the same prompt: ``` Risk = medium (confidence high) [What this code does] Writes ~300 words of acceptance notes to \note.txt outside the workspace, using danger-full-access (cwd is ). The text itself only describes a timeout fix and its measurements. [What the model is trying to achieve] You explicitly asked it to file an escalation request, so the model deliberately writes outside the workspace to trigger a real approval prompt and measure annotation latency. [Why this risk level] The content is harmless and this is not production, but it explicitly asks for danger-full-access and targets a path outside the workspace. That falls under permission and security controls, so the standard rating is medium. [Recommendation] Approve once: the content is harmless and matches your instruction, but let it through only this time rather than granting standing full-disk access. [What each option means] Approve once -> the text is really written to \note.txt and stays on disk until you delete it; other writes under the same grant are also allowed. Deny -> nothing is written and the latency check cannot complete; the model is told it was denied and may retry inside the workspace or stop and ask you. ``` Note the last block. It does not just say "the command will run" — it says the file will really be created, that it can be deleted, and that other writes are covered by the same grant. That is the information a decision needs. ### Design notes | | | |---|---| | **Only real approvals** | No annotations for routine tool calls. In one measurement `approval/request` fired 2 times while `tools/pre-execute` fired 259 — annotating everything is the same as annotating nothing | | **Never blocks approval** | Generation runs in the background; the prompt appears immediately. A failure or timeout cannot affect what you may approve | | **Failures are visible** | When generation fails the panel shows why instead of hanging silently | | **Arguments come from the session** | Tool arguments are looked up by `callId` in the session log, with three fallbacks. If they cannot be found the annotation says so instead of inventing them | | **Prompt-injection resistant** | The system prompt states that code, paths, and commands are data, not instructions | | **Does not change policy** | It observes the approval waterfall; it does not decide who may be authorized | ## How it works The plugin is a DSH **bundle**: an npm package carrying a `cordis.patch.yml` that contributes one configuration layer to a profile. ``` package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch, pointing at the layer file cordis.patch.yml the layer: one insert row referencing the package by name lib/index.js host half (Node) lib/client.js browser half (Web) ``` The whole install mechanism is five lines of YAML: ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-approval-explainer name: dsh-approval-explainer # by package name, so Node resolution finds the installed code inject: - llm - approval ``` `dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile and, because the package declares `dsh.bundle`, appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The effective config gains one layer. ### The two halves ``` lib/index.js host half (Node) observes the approval/request waterfall, generates annotations in the background via the LLM, caches them, serves 8 HTTP routes lib/client.js browser half (Web) registers into the conversation.approval.detail slot and renders the command plus the annotation card ``` ### Key decisions **Only `approval/request` is hooked.** It is the only precise signal for "the user is being asked to decide something right now". An earlier version also hooked `tools/pre-execute` to pre-generate; the measured signal-to-noise was 259:2, where 259 routine operations drowned the 2 that mattered. **Approval is never blocked.** The listener starts background generation and immediately `return next()`, handing the decision back to the real policy listener. So a successful, failed, or timed-out generation cannot affect what you may approve. **Arguments are looked up in the session log.** The `approval/request` event carries **no tool arguments** (only `toolName`, `callId`, `reason`), so the plugin finds the `tool/call` event by `callId` with three fallbacks (`surface.nodes` → `snapshotEvents()` → `events`). When it cannot, the annotation says arguments are missing rather than inventing them. **Shadowing the official renderer requires an explicit priority.** `conversation.approval.detail` is a **single** slot, and the official `dsh-client-ui-chat` already occupies `priority: 0`. Two registrations at the same priority in one slot is an error, and `entriesOfSlot` takes the first entry in **ascending** priority order — so shadowing requires a **lower** number (`-1`). The cost is having to re-render the command line yourself. ### Two hard constraints **1. Never inject a client bundle yourself.** `dsh-client-modules` deduplicates by URL but rejects duplicate registrations by module id. If the host injects another `

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-patch-library

**The official DSH core patches, as data — and five ways to apply them.**

**官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本 —— 10 条补丁，5 种打法。**

Ten self-contained patches for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, plus a small
applier that finds *your* DSH installation by itself. No hard-coded paths, no personal information
anywhere in this repository, no network access required.

十条自成体系的补丁，覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`；配一个小巧的应用器，
它会**自己找到你的 DSH 安装位置**。零硬编码路径、仓库里没有任何个人信息、全程不需要联网。

> 🌐 **中文完整说明（推荐中文读者从这里开始）** → **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**
>
> 中文读者还应该看这两份：[`教程-安装与官方补丁` 里的补丁库章节](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim/blob/main/tutorial-install-and-official-patches.zh-CN.md)
> 与 [给 agent 的中文提示词](PROMPT.zh-CN.md)。

> Built for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2** (the 1.5 line). Every patch records the exact
> sha256 of both the file it expects and the file it produces, so the applier can tell you
> `exact` / `applied` / `conflict` before it touches anything.

---

## Why this repository exists

Some fixes cannot be shipped as a plugin: they have to run *inside* an official file, in the middle
of a function that Cordis does not expose as a seam. Four of those fixes were already published as
plugins (`dsh-context-reclaim`, `dsh-capability-composer`, `dsh-composer-launcher`,
`dsh-aux-degrade`). The rest — plus the ones that only matter if you want the full set — live here,
as ordinary unified diffs that anyone can read, review, apply, revert, or regenerate.

Nothing here is a binary blob and nothing here is magic: `patches/<id>/change.diff` is a normal
patch, and `manifest.json` is the metadata that lets a script apply it safely and reversibly.

## The ten patches

| id | package → file | kind | size | restart | already handled by a plugin? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-llm-writable-request` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +18 −1 | yes | **yes — `dsh-context-reclaim`** |
| `agent-loop-snapshot-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +97 −20 | yes | no |
| `llm-pi-ai-system-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +96 −54 | yes | no |
| `compaction-pruner` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +354 −14 | yes | no |
| `ui-renderer-turntail` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` → `lib/client.js` | lines | +9 −1 | no | no |
| `ui-sidebar-wrap` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` → `lib/lib-client.js` | **regex** | +1 −1 | no | no |
| `session-format-v1-to-v2` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `session-persistence-jsonl` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `lib/worker.cjs` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `mcp-client` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +59 −6 | yes | no |
| `pi-ai-max-tokens-floor` | `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `dist/api/simple-options.js` | lines | +11 −1 | yes | no |

Every patch has its own `patches/<id>/NOTES.md` with **what it changes, when you want it, how to
verify it, and what to do if it does not fit your build** — in English and Chinese.

`ui-sidebar-wrap` is a **regex** patch on purpose: the sidebar's class prefix is a build hash, so a
line diff would be invalidated by any rebuild. `patches/<id>/change.json` stores the pattern and its
explicit inverse.

## Five ways to apply them

Pick whichever matches how you like to work. All five are documented step by step in
[`docs/methods.md`](docs/methods.md) (Chinese: [`docs/methods.zh-CN.md`](docs/methods.zh-CN.md)).

| | method | command |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | script (recommended) | `node apply.mjs --check` then `node apply.mjs --apply --all` |
| **B** | `git apply` | `cd <pkg dir> && git apply -p1 <library>/patches/<id>/change.diff` |
| **C** | your own AI agent | paste the block from [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and let it do A or B for you |
| **D** | regenerate for your build | `node tools/make-patch.mjs --file <patched> --orig <pristine> --pkg <pkg> --rel <rel>` |
| **E** | revert | `node apply.mjs --revert --all`, or restore any `*.orig` by hand |

All ten diffs were verified with `git apply -p1 --check` inside the package directory, so method B
works on every one of them.

### Method A in full

```bash
node apply.mjs --list                 # what is in here
node apply.mjs --roots                # which DSH installations were found on this machine
node apply.mjs --check                # per-file state: exact / applied / conflict / missing
node apply.mjs --apply --all          # apply everything that fits
node apply.mjs --apply --only mcp-client,compaction-pruner
node apply.mjs --revert --all         # put every .orig backup back
```

`--check` reports one of:

| state | meaning |
|---|---|
| `exact` | the file is the pristine version this library was built from — applying is safe |
| `applied` | the file already equals the patched version, nothing to do |
| `variant` | same version, different build (hash differs) but the hunks still fit — needs `--allow-variant`, or method D |
| `conflict` | the hunks do not fit. **Nothing is written.** Use method D to regenerate for your build |
| `missing` | that package is not part of the installation that was found |

### What the applier guarantees

* **It finds your installation, it does not assume one.** `--root`, `$DSH_APP_ROOT`,
  `$DSH_INSTALL_ROOT`, `$DSH_HOME` (including `profiles/*`), the running process's own DSH path,
  a `node` resolution from the current directory, and a bounded scan of the usual install locations
  for Windows / macOS / Linux — see `lib/discover.mjs`. `--root` means *exactly* that root, never
  that root plus whatever else was found.
* **`.orig` is sacred.** A backup is written once, next to the file, and never overwritten. If a
  `.orig` already exists, it is reused.
* **Every edit is syntax-checked.** `node --check` runs after each write; on failure the backup is
  restored immediately and the patch is reported as failed.
* **A hunk that does not fit is a conflict, never a guess.** The engine matches a hunk's old side
  exactly, exactly once, near the position it was recorded at.
* **It only writes inside the resolved root.** Nothing under `$DSH_HOME` is touched except, if you
  explicitly point `--root` at a profile directory, that profile's own `node_modules` copy of a
  package.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a requested action failed or conflicted, `2` no installation found.

## If you already run the four DSH plugins

You can skip `dsh-llm-writable-request` — `dsh-context-reclaim` takes over that path from inside the
plugin, with the official patch reverted. `--check` says so explicitly:

```
= dsh-llm-writable-request     already    node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js
    not needed: the dsh-context-reclaim plugin already handles this
```

The other nine are independent of the plugins: install neither, one, or both.

## Self-test

```bash
node verify.mjs
```

Offline, no DSH installation required. It checks that every diff parses and its hunk counts agree,
that the declared marker really is added by its patch, that the apply/revert engine round-trips on
synthetic samples, that a duplicated context is rejected instead of guessed, that the regex patch
round-trips through any class prefix — and that **no file in this repository contains a drive
letter, a personal home directory or a private workspace name** (that scan is part of the test
suite, not a promise).

`verify.mjs` finishes with a read-only `--check` summary of whatever installation it finds.

## Repository layout

```
apply.mjs             the applier: --list --roots --check --apply --revert --show
verify.mjs            offline self-test + personal-information scan
manifest.json         every patch's metadata: hashes, sizes, markers, risk, why, applyWhen
lib/manifest.mjs      manifest loading and schema checks
lib/discover.mjs      finds DSH installations (fully adaptive, platform-aware)
lib/unified.mjs       unified-diff parse / apply / revert engine
lib/backup.mjs        .orig backup and restore
lib/hash.mjs          sha256 helpers
patches/<id>/change.diff   the patch itself

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 挂一个烧心体人格：改 Markdown 就是改人格，保存即生效。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-persona-shaoxin

**给 DeepSeek Harness 挂一个"擦不锈钢桌子的老实摊主"人格——烧心体。改 Markdown 就是改人格，保存即生效。**

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mycatqiezi/dsh-persona-shaoxin)

已收录于 [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/mycatqiezi/dsh-persona-shaoxin)（status: verified）。

## 装完有什么变化

同一件事，两种说法：

| 普通写法 | 挂上之后 |
|---|---|
| 我们的定价稍高，主要是因为选用了品质更好的原材料 | 贵是贵点。但吃了不烧心。 |
| 面对同行的低价策略，我们会坚持品质定位 | 怕亏钱吗？怕。**但更怕坏规矩。** |
| 我们对这批不合格产品进行了报废处理 | 剩下怎么办？**倒掉。** |

每条回答走六幕节奏：钩子 → 打压 → 升级 → 反击 → 留钩子，**绝不给圆满结局**。单句不超过 15 个字。

## 特性

- **文件驱动**：人格写在 md 里，不在代码里。六件套 `SOUL / IDENTITY / USER / LINES / MEMORY / TOOLS`。
- **改完即生效**：`fs.watch` 防抖 150ms 自动重挂载，不用重启 dsh。
- **台词库**：`LINES.md` 是一整套可被直接调用的素材——招牌句、四大句式填空模板、万能替换词表、二字段、反例对照。换【货】就长出一部新剧。
- **项目级覆盖**：`<项目根>/.dsh/persona/*.md` 同名覆盖全局，没放的仍读全局。
- **零构建**：纯 JS ESM，无 TypeScript、无 `prepare` 脚本 → 自动安装，**不会触发 `--allow-build` 授权**。
- **安全兜底**：挂载时扫描 `{{…}}` 模板语法并告警，防止提示词变量严格插值把 session 干掉。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MycatQieZi/dsh-persona-shaoxin
```

支持的 profile：`web`（其他 profile 需自行验证 `systemPrompt` 服务是否可用）。安装后重启 dsh web 生效。

## 用法（最小示例）

**1. 放人设文件**

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/persona
cp persona/*.md ~/.dsh/persona/
```

**2. 改你想改的那句**

```
~/.dsh/persona/LINES.md
  贵是贵点，但用了不烧心。
```

保存，150ms 后自动生效。发下一条消息就是新人格。

**3. 让它写剧本**

> 写一个 45 秒的烧心体短剧，卖的东西是纳鞋底。

它会给你进场钩子、压迫感、反转、以及一句能截图的收尾。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-persona-shaoxin/
├── index.js            插件入口：apply(ctx, config)
├── cordis.patch.yml    安装时贡献的配置层
├── package.json        dsh.bundle 声明
├── persona/            人设本体（改这里）
│   ├── SOUL.md         行为准则：三条铁律、四大句式、六幕节奏、禁止清单
│   ├── IDENTITY.md     身份：擦不锈钢桌子的老实摊主
│   ├── USER.md         用户：写短剧的人，要能直接用的台词
│   ├── LINES.md        台词库（核心资产）
│   ├── MEMORY.md       长期记忆
│   └── TOOLS.md        环境备忘
└── samples/
    └── before-after.md  六种场景的普通写法 vs 烧心体对照
```

## 配置

改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `config`：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `order` | `1` | 落位。官方档位：harness 身份 −1000 / persona 前缀 0 / 计划 500 / 工具指导 1000–3000 / 结构化输出 9900 / persona 后缀 10200 |
| `section` | `deployment:shaoxin` | 别改成 `deployment:persona`，那是 prompt 注册表自己的槽位，同名 loud-fail |
| `files` | 六件套 | 想调淡删掉 `LINES.md`；想调浓把它排到 `SOUL.md` 前面 |
| `maxChars` | `24000` | 截断上限 |
| `watch` | `true` | 关掉就是纯静态，只在加载时读一次 |

## 它是怎么工作的

DSH 在每个模型步骤前由 `dsh-system-prompt` 按 order 拼装系统提示词。插件只要：

```js
export const inject = ['systemPrompt']
const dispose = ctx.systemPrompt.section({ name, order, text })
```

就往提示词里插了一段。`text` 是模板 —— `{{cwd}}` / `{{model}}` 会严格插值，**未注册的变量会报错**，所以本插件在挂载时会把它扫出来告警（用【】做占位符，别用 `{{ }}`）。

## 权限与隐私

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 磁盘读取 | 仅读 `<cwd>/.dsh/persona/` 与 `$DSH_HOME/persona/` 下的 md 文件 |
| 磁盘写入 | 无。（首次运行会 `mkdir` 全局 persona 目录） |
| 网络 | 无任何出站请求，无 telemetry |
| 执行的命令 | 无 |
| 挂载面 | 只注册一个 system-prompt section，不注册工具、不改模型路由、不碰沙箱与审批策略 |

## 兼容性

- **目标 DSH 版本**：0.1.0 系列；依赖 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` ≥ 4.0.4 与 `systemPrompt` 服务契约。
- **状态**：作者尚未在真机 dsh 上完成端到端挂载验证（本机未安装 dsh）。已完成的是**假 ctx 逻辑冒烟**——六文件拼装 4128 字符、section 落位正确、`{{cwd}}` 误写告警如期触发。首个真机反馈欢迎开 Issue。
- DSH 尚在开发者预览期，上游 API 可能 breaking，README 会跟进标注适用区间。

## 梗从哪来

2026 年 AI 市井短剧跑出来的热梗：良心摊主用好料被迫提价 → 隔壁低价黑心同行抢客 → 被嘲笑"不会做生意" → 擦锃亮不锈钢桌甩一句"怕亏钱，但更怕坏规矩" → 黑心店翻车 → 顾客回流一句"贵是贵点，但吃了不烧心"。同一模板换汤不换药，观众从"看剧"变成"背剧"，把它玩成了梗。抖音 #不烧心# 播放超 20 亿。

保留[LINES.md](persona/LINES.md)里的替换词表，下次换梗改三列就行，骨架不用动。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 MycatQieZi

plugins.description: Resource lease governance: auto-registers browser tabs, background jobs, processes and ports as session-owned leases with TTL auto-reclaim, pinning and manual sweep.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-resource-lease — 资源租约治理插件

解决「agent 打开浏览器 tab / 后台 job / 临时进程后忘记关」的问题。**不依赖模型自觉**：资源打开即自动登记租约（归属会话 + TTL），回收由机制执行。

## 三层防线

1. **自动登记**（tools/result 观察钩子，零提示词依赖）
   - browser_tab_new → browser-tab 租约（tabId + 归属会话 + TTL，默认 240min）
   - bash/subagent/workflow 带 run_in_background → job 租约（jobId，默认 360min）
   - 其他资源（run_code 里起的服务器等）→ lease_register 工具手动登记
2. **自动回收**（三个触发点互为冗余）
   - session/disposed → 关闭该会话全部 session 级租约（正常路径）
   - daemon 每 60s 扫 TTL 过期租约（会话挂死兜底）
   - 启动 10s 后扫过期账（宿主重启兜底；注册表持久化于 ~/.dsh/resource-lease/leases.json）
   - 浏览器空闲 10min 且**实查 0 残留 tab** 才 browser_close（共享实例安全闸：有未登记 tab 绝不误关）
3. **分类策略**
   - session（默认）：随会话/TTL 自动回收
   - pinned：用户说「这个留着」→ lease_pin 升级，永不自动回收
   - system：白名单（cron/watchdog 服务、外部 Chrome 本来就不登记，天然豁免）

## 工具面（agent）

| 工具 | 用途 |
|------|------|
| lease_list | 列租约（默认当前会话活跃；all=true 全部） |
| lease_register | 手动登记（kind=process/port/custom；process/port 需 pid） |
| lease_pin | pinned 升级/降级 |
| lease_release | 立即关闭（force=true 连 pinned 也关） |
| lease_sweep | 立即扫一轮（给 sessionId 则清该会话） |

## 面板（conversation.view slot「资源租约」）

活跃租约表 + 单个关闭/固定 + 清扫过期，10s 自动刷新。宿主 API：/resource-lease/api/{leases,release,pin,sweep}。

## 回收执行路径（实测）

- browser tab → ctx.tools.execute('browser_tab_close')（无 agent 上下文可用，PTC 不拦）
- job → ctx.jobs.kill(jobId, sessionId, reason) 直连服务（job_kill 工具是 agent 作用域注册，全局视图不可见——v1 实测踩坑）
- process/port → process.kill(pid, SIGTERM)
- 「资源已不存在」（not found/ESRCH/already-finished）视为关闭成功；'unknown tool' 不算——连续失败 3 次标 failed 停止重试，面板可见待人工处理

## 构建（离线，无需 npm install）

- host：bash scripts/build.sh（DSH_CHECKOUT 自动探测 ~/dsh-harness）
- client：bash scripts/build-client.sh（tsc CJS + 手工 __ModuleLoader__ 包装，替代 tsdown）
- 一键：dev_build_plugin → dev_inject_plugin / dev_reload_package 热重载

## 配置（cordis.patch.yml 可覆盖）

sweepIntervalMs(60s) tabTtlMinutes(240) jobTtlMinutes(360) autoCloseBrowser(true) browserIdleCloseMs(10min) keepClosedHours(72)

plugins.description: Named database connections for DeepSeek Harness - configure MySQL in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat. Read-only by default, writes opt-in per connection.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-db-connections

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Named database connections** for DeepSeek Harness. Configure your databases in a settings page, then refer to them by name in chat — say "use 128" and the model knows which database to reach and how.

## The problem it solves

Asking an AI to query a database normally means restating host, port, user, and password every time. This plugin stores those in configuration and leaves one short name (`128`) for you and the model to use:

- The connection names are contributed to the system prompt, so "use 128" resolves without you repeating an address or a credential.
- All three tools take `connection` as their first argument, so the model only carries names.
- **No password ever reaches the prompt** — only host, port, default schema, and whether the connection is writable.

## Install

Plugin directory: `<path-to>/dsh-db-connections`

Install dependencies first (`mysql2` and `yaml`):

```sh
cd <path-to>/dsh-db-connections
npm install
```

Then install into a profile with the DSH plugin command. The Electron desktop app owns its `desktop` profile exclusively, so use the CLI the app ships:

```sh
# Default Windows desktop path; substitute your own if installed elsewhere.
"C:\Program Files\deepseek\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" ^
  plugin --profile desktop add "<path-to>/dsh-db-connections"
```

`dsh plugin add` records the package in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `id: db-connections` row with `connections: []` (connect to nothing by default).

Any other profile (`web`, `tui`, your own) uses the ordinary CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-db-connections
```

> **Restart the desktop app once after installing**, so the settings page appears: the client-plugin roster is scanned at startup, not re-scanned while running.
>
> Conversely, **the plugin directory must not be deleted, renamed, or moved**: the profile references it through a `link:`, and a missing directory produces `cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-db-connections"`.

## Configure a database

Two routes, one configuration — use whichever you prefer.

### Route 1: click through the app (recommended)

Open **Settings → Databases** to add, edit, and delete connections, pick **read-only** or **read-write** per connection from a dropdown, and press **Test** to verify a connection on the spot. Saving applies immediately — no restart, and no need to touch the configuration file.

The page follows the shell's own language setting (Chinese/English): dictionaries are contributed with `ctx.locale.register()` and lookups go through `ctx.locale.bind()`, rather than guessing from the browser, so the page follows a language switch.

Passwords are shown and edited as plain text: the value lives in a file you own, and hiding it only makes a wrong password impossible to spot.

### Route 2: edit the configuration file

**Redefine** the `db-connections` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The loader replaces a row's whole `config` rather than deep-merging it, so restate every key:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"              # the name you and the model use in chat
        host: 192.0.2.10
        port: 3306               # optional, default 3306
        user: root
        password: "change-me"       # or use passwordEnv, below
        database: appdb     # optional default schema
        description: dev database # optional; shown in the prompt
        allowWrite: false        # optional, default false = read-only
```

Where the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` lives:

| Platform | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` |
| macOS / Linux | `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` |

Press **Reload** on the settings page, or restart the app, to apply a hand edit. A change made through the settings page needs neither.

### Several connections

`connections` is a list, in order; names must be unique:

```yaml
- id: db-connections
  name: "dsh-db-connections"
  config:
    connections:
      - name: "128"
        host: 192.0.2.10
        user: root
        password: "change-me"
        database: appdb
        description: dev database
      - name: "prod"
        host: 192.0.2.9
        user: readonly_user
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD   # keeps the secret out of the file
        database: app_prod
        description: production (read-only account)
      - name: "local"
        host: 127.0.0.1
        user: root
        password: ""
        description: local MySQL
```

### Keep the password out of the file

Name an environment variable with `passwordEnv`; it is resolved at load, and a missing variable fails loudly rather than becoming an empty password:

```yaml
        passwordEnv: PROD_DB_PASSWORD
```

When both are present, `passwordEnv` wins. **A settings-page save does not destroy this**: the page edits raw configuration, so a resolved password is never written back to the file. Note the other direction: the settings page has no `passwordEnv` field of its own — creating the indirection is a hand edit of the configuration file.

### Write access

**Set per connection, read-only by default.** The settings page's dropdown ("Read-only" / "Read-write") is exactly the `allowWrite` flag in the configuration file.

Read-only has two independent layers, neither of which is keyword matching in the plugin:

1. With `allowWrite: false` (the default), `db_execute` refuses outright.
2. Even on a writable connection, every `db_query` statement runs inside a server-enforced `START TRANSACTION READ ONLY` — **MySQL rejects the write** — so bypass-shaped statements such as `SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE`, `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`, and `WITH ... UPDATE` are refused by the server too.

Before enabling writes, confirm the database should accept changes from the agent. A read-only account is the better choice for most deployments than turning on `allowWrite`.

## The three tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `db_query` | Read-only queries, in a server-enforced read-only transaction. Returns columns plus rows. |
| `db_execute` | Writes (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Available only with `allowWrite: true`. |
| `db_schema` | Inspect structure: omit `database` to list schemas; pass `database` to list tables; add `table` for columns, indexes, and DDL. |

You do not call these yourself. Typical requests:

- "list the schemas on 128" → `db_schema`
- "what does sys_user look like in 128?" → `db_schema`
- "show me the first 10 users in 128" → `db_query`
- "change the remark on id=1 in 128" → `db_execute` (needs a writable connection)

## Per-connection options

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | required | Connection name, unique, ≤64 characters |
| `host` | required | Hostname or IP |
| `user` | required | Account name |
| `password` | `''` | Password, stored as plain text in the configuration file |
| `passwordEnv` | — | Environment variable holding the password; wins over `password` |
| `port` | `3306` | TCP port |
| `driver` | `mysql` | Only `mysql` is supported |
| `database` | — | Default schema; without it, qualify SQL as `schema.table` |
| `description` | — | Shown in the prompt, for context |
| `allowWrite` | `false` | Whether this connection accepts writes; the settings page's read-only / read-write dropdown |
| `ssl` | `false` | Connect over TLS |
| `connectTimeoutMs` | `10000` | Connection timeout |
| `queryTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-statement timeout (client and server `MAX_EXECUTION_TIME`) |
| `maxRows` | `200` | Rows returned per call; an excess is reported, never silently dropped |
| `maxCellChars` | `500` | Characters kept per cell |
| `maxDdlChars` | `20000` | Bound for the table DDL `db_schema` returns, kept separate so a CREATE TABLE is not cut off |
| `connectionLimit` | `4` | Pool size |

A bad configuration fails **at plugin load** naming the offending key, rather than when the model first calls a tool.

## Security notes

- Passwords never appear in the prompt or in tool results.
- Read-only comes from a server

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-license-guard)


**开源许可与许可证合规**：发版前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍 —— 把 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知、缺 LICENSE 这几类风险找出来。

**关键词**：开源许可 · 开源协议 · 许可证合规 · 许可风险 · GPL 传染 · AGPL · 开源合规 · 许可证
**Keywords**: open source license · license compliance · GPL · AGPL · copyleft · license risk
**开源许可合规检查** —— 扫依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险。

发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。退出码可挂 CI。

## 不装它会怎样

你的产物里混进了一个 **GPL 依赖**，你没发现，打包发出去了。

半年后客户审计问：「你用了 GPL 代码，为什么没开源？」——
**GPL 的义务从「分发」那一刻就触发了**，而分发在半年前。

这个检查跑一次几秒钟。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | GPL / AGPL —— 强传染 |
| 🟡 中 | 许可未知（没写许可证 ≠ 随便用）· 项目缺 LICENSE |
| 🟢 低 | LGPL / MPL / EPL · package.json 缺 license 字段 |

## 安装

```bash
# DSH 插件（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard

# 或纯 CLI（不依赖 DSH）
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-license-guard
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-license-guard                # 扫当前目录
dsh-license-guard --demo         # 用内置样本看效果
dsh-license-guard --html r.html  # 输出 HTML 报告
```

![dsh-license-guard 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/report.png)

![dsh-license-guard 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/demo.png)

![dsh-license-guard 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-license-guard/rules.png)

## 覆盖范围

**5 条规则**，覆盖依赖树的许可风险 + 项目基础文件。

**不覆盖**：专利条款、商标、出口管制、SSPL/BUSL 等非 SPDX 自定义协议。
依赖声明的许可证值可能不准（维护者写错），本工具**不校验其真实性**。

## 为什么和其他工具不同

它**不只看依赖**，也看**你自己**：项目缺 LICENSE、package.json 缺 license 字段 ——
这两条会让别人（和你自己的下游）无法判断能不能用你的代码。

## 边界

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

## 开发

```bash
npm install
bash tests/run.sh     # 双向验证（正例必须报 + 反例必须不报）
```

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: treat a real Android phone as a device the agent can inspect and tidy up over adb — free up storage, find what is eating the disk, clear caches, uninstall, screenshot. No root required. / 免 root 的手机设备管家：查存储、清缓存、卸载应用、截图。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-phone-butler

**把一台真实的 Android 手机，变成 agent 可以查看和打理的一台设备 —— 全部走 adb，不需要 root。**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that puts a real
Android phone within reach of the agent: free up storage, find what is eating the disk, measure
directories, clear an app cache without touching its data, uninstall, screenshot.

```
phone_status   is a phone reachable, and what is it
phone_scan     read-only: cleanup survey · per-app data sizes · caches · usage · big files
phone_fs       ls / du on /sdcard
phone_act      the only writer: clear-cache · rm · uninstall   (each gated by confirm=true)
phone_shot     screenshot to a local file
```

Plus one bundled skill, `phone-butler`: the capability map, the connection recipes and the five
traps that produced wrong answers.

---

## 为什么值得存在

「手机空间满了」这件事，通常被三个互相矛盾的印象搅在一起：文件管理器说能清，系统设置说
腾不出空间，而真正的元凶躺在一个看不见的目录里。

这个插件做两件具体的事：

1. **把可清理的与不可清理的分开说。** `/sdcard` 全层（**含每个 App 的 `Android/data` 与
   `Android/obb`**）可读写；`/data/data` 未 root 一律碰不到 —— 那是聊天数据库住的地方。
   把这两层混为一谈，是大多数"手机管家"话术的来源。
2. **让那层碰不到的东西至少可以被度量。** `phone_scan kind=apps` 解析
   `dumpsys diskstats` 的并列数组，**未 root 也能列出每个 App 的私有数据大小**（它同时覆盖
   `/data/data` 与外部 `Android/data`）。所以"到底是哪个 App 吃掉了手机"有了确定答案，
   而不是靠猜。

## 安装

在 DSH 里，用官方的 bundle 安装姿势指向本目录（或它的克隆）：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录绝对路径>
```

它需要 `adb`：在 `PATH` 里，或用 `DSH_PHONE_ADB` 指向具体可执行文件，或放在 Android SDK
的常规位置。可选配置（在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-phone-butler
  config:
    adbPath: 'C:\platform-tools\adb.exe'
    timeoutMs: 240000
```

## 安全立场（这是设计里最要紧的部分）

- **读永远不改动任何东西。**
- **写必须显式 `confirm: true`**；否则工具**什么都不执行**，只返回它本来会执行的计划 ——
  把计划摆给用户看、得到同意，再发一次。
- **`rm` 只接受 `/sdcard` 之下的路径**，其它一律拒绝（含测试断言）。
- **扫描默认不列文件名。** 一份来自某人 Download 文件夹的文件清单默认是隐私；`names: true`
  是一次明确的索要。
- **Android 没有回收站。** `rm` 就是最终结果。

## 能力边界（实测，不是推测）

| 层 | 能否触达 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `/sdcard/**` | **可以，读写皆可** | 含每个 App 的 `Android/data`、`Android/obb` |
| `/data/data/<pkg>` | **不可以** | 未 root `Permission denied`；`run-as` 拒绝非 debuggable 包 |
| 每个 App 的数据**大小** | **可以** | `dumpsys diskstats`（覆盖私有层） |
| 只清缓存 | **可以** | `pm clear --cache-only <pkg>`，数据保留 |
| 清空 App 数据 | 技术上可以，但会毁数据 | 本插件**故意不暴露** |

## 连接手机（最容易踩空的一段）

有两条互相独立的通道，行为完全不同：

| 通道 | 绑在哪 | 离开 Wi-Fi 还活着吗 |
|---|---|---|
| **无线调试**（Android 11+） | **WLAN**（开关原文：「连接到 WLAN 后启用调试模式」） | **不活** —— 关掉 Wi-Fi，adbd 就不再监听 |
| **`adb tcpip 5555`** | adbd 进程本身，监听 `0.0.0.0:5555` | **活着** —— 远程能力就靠这个 |

所以想让不在同一网络的手机可达：先在同一个 Wi-Fi 下执行**一次** `adb tcpip 5555`；此后手机
一直听着 5555，任何能路由到它地址的人（例如经过 Tailscale 这类 VPN）都能
`adb connect <手机地址>:5555` 连上。手机重启后失效，需要重做。

找无线调试端口：`adb mdns services` 会直接打印 `IP:端口`。

## 五个会产出错误结论的坑

1. **`find /sdcard` 静默返回空。** `/sdcard` 是符号链接
   （`/sdcard → /storage/self/primary → /storage/emulated/0`），toybox 的 `find` 默认不跟随。
   结果是一份空列表和退出码 0 —— 与"这台手机很干净"完全无法区分。
   **必须 `find -H /sdcard`。** 有一次"没有大文件、没有空目录"的报告就是这么来的，
   而那台手机两样都有几千个。
2. **别把带双引号的命令经 PowerShell 递给 `adb shell`。** 引号会被吃掉，管道错位，
   得到一个静默的空结果。用 argv 数组传参。
3. **推到手机上的脚本必须是 LF 换行。** CRLF 会让 shell 报 `id\r: inaccessible or not found`。
4. **全黑的截图是锁屏，不是抓取失败** —— 比文件大小（约 18 KB 黑屏 vs 几 MB 有内容），
   或查 `dumpsys power`。
5. **别从截图里读路径。** OCR 会混淆 `l`/`1`、`I`/`1`。问设备：`pm path <包名>`。

## 一条共存提醒

如果同一台电脑上有多个 agent，它们**共用同一个 adb server**。`adb kill-server` 会把所有人
一起断掉；只断自己那条，用 `adb disconnect <地址>`。

## 开发

```
node test/selftest.mjs            # 离线断言（纯函数 + 引擎安全语义 + 注册形状）
node test/selftest.mjs --device   # 另跑一轮真实的只读调用
```

`lib/adb.js` 是纯 Node，不从 DSH 导入任何东西 —— 所以引擎可以脱离 harness 直接测试。
`lib/entry.js` 同样零 DSH 导入：一个装在 profile 之外的 `link:` 插件无法解析
`@deepseek-ai/*`，一次这样的 import 就会让整个入口加载失败。

## License

MIT © 2026 Void-LifeStream

---

*Tested against a Xiaomi HyperOS device running Android 17 with an unrooted adb shell; the
limits above were measured there rather than assumed.*

plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness its own persistent computer: a bundled microVM with shell, browser, live view and approval gates
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-computer **English** | [中文](#中文说明) Give [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) its own computer: a persistent Linux microVM with a browser, a live desktop view, and approval gates. No Docker required. ![dsh-computer demo](docs/demo.gif) *The agent runs commands and opens a page inside its own VM; the Computer panel in dsh shows its desktop live. (Recorded with a scripted model.)* - **Every agent command runs in the VM**, never on your machine. The session's workspace folder is shared into the VM at the same path. - **Its own browser** (`mcp__vm__browser_*` tools), with logins that persist across restarts. - **Live view inside dsh**: a monitor button in the session header opens a Computer tab in the right sidebar. Watch, click, type, or take over for a QR login or CAPTCHA. - **Audit log**: every command, VM tool call, approval and folder change is appended to `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`. - **Phone-friendly live view**: set `publicUrl` (e.g. via `tailscale serve`) and approval messages — including IM approval cards — link to it. - **Approval gates** for risky actions (`sudo`, `rm -rf`, `curl | sh`, `git push`, payment/login/delete clicks), with a link to the live view. - **Always there**: the VM keeps running after dsh quits and dsh reconnects to the same machine on next start. - **Lightweight**: a bundled [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) microVM (Hypervisor.framework on Apple silicon, WHP on Windows, KVM on Linux); Intel Macs fall back to Docker. ### Install (dsh desktop, macOS) ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` The first start pulls the VM image (a few GB); agent commands queue until it is ready. Choose the **Computer** permission preset under the input box. Status: v0.5.0, verified on dsh desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (macOS, Apple silicon). Want a Dots-style always-on agent on top of this (IM, schedules, budget caps)? See **[dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)**. Design notes and roadmap: [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) (Chinese). MIT licensed. --- ## 中文说明 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）一台自己的电脑：一台常驻的 Linux 微型虚拟机，带浏览器、实时桌面画面和审批闸门。不需要装 Docker。 - agent 的 bash 命令在虚拟机里执行，不碰你的系统。 - agent 的浏览器（`mcp__vm__browser_*` 工具）在虚拟机里，登录态长期保留。 - 你随时可以打开实时画面观看或接手操作（扫码、验证码）。 - 危险操作（`sudo`、`rm -rf`、`curl | sh`、`git push`，以及涉及支付、登录、删除的浏览器动作）先弹审批，审批信息附实时画面链接。 - 会话所在的工作区文件夹自动共享进虚拟机，路径不变。 - dsh 退出后虚拟机继续运行；下次启动自动连回同一台。 当前版本 0.5.0，在 dsh 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（macOS，Apple 芯片）上验证通过。 ## 一、要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | 系统 | macOS（Apple 芯片）、Linux（有 `/dev/kvm`）、Windows（开启 Hypervisor Platform）。Intel Mac 自动改用 Docker | | 内存 | 虚拟机默认 4GB 上限，空闲约 0.5GB | | 磁盘 | 约 10GB 空闲（虚拟机镜像） | | 网络 | 首次启动要从 `ghcr.io` 下载镜像；插件会自动使用系统代理 | 虚拟机由 [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) 运行（libkrun 微型虚拟机，macOS 用 Hypervisor.framework）。它随插件的 npm 依赖一起安装，不需要单独安装。 ## 二、安装 ### dsh 桌面版（macOS） 桌面版使用名为 `desktop` 的配置，要用 App 自带的 dsh 命令安装： ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' # 先退出桌面版 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` 重新打开后，在输入框下方的权限选择里会出现 **Computer** 预设。 ### 命令行版 ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer cd ~/某个项目 && dsh web ``` ### 第一次启动 插件会自动下载镜像（几 GB）并创建虚拟机，这期间 agent 的命令排队等待，不会报错。完成后日志出现： ``` computer ready — live view: http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` ## 三、共享文件夹 - 在某个工作区新建会话并执行命令时，插件自动把这个工作区共享进虚拟机，路径和本机一致。比如 `/Users/你/Documents/项目` 在虚拟机里也是这个路径。 - 共享新文件夹需要重建虚拟机：停机 → 磁盘快照 → 带新文件夹恢复，大约 20 秒。期间的命令自动排队，虚拟机里的文件、安装的软件和浏览器登录态都保留。 - **不会自动共享**：家目录本身、隐藏目录（如 `~/.dsh`、`~/.ssh`）、`~/Library`、`~/Applications`，以及家目录以外的位置。在这些位置启动时，命令在虚拟机的 `/home/gem` 里执行，并共享 `~/dsh-computer/workspace`。 - 想固定共享某些文件夹，在设置里写 `mounts`（见第五节）。显式写出的文件夹不受上面的限制。 ## 四、观看与接管 **在 dsh 界面里**：会话顶部右侧有一个显示器按钮，点一下就在右侧栏打开"虚拟机"标签页，可以直接点击和输入；再点一下收起。也可以在右侧栏的"+"引导页里选"虚拟机"。虚拟机还没就绪时，标签页会显示等待状态并自动重试。 **在浏览器里**： ``` http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` 看到的就是 agent 的电脑桌面，可以直接点击、输入。 **在手机上（不在电脑旁时）**：端口只监听本机，不要直接暴露到公网。推荐用 [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) 把它安全地转发到你自己的设备： ```bash tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:18080 # 只在你的 tailnet 内可见 ``` 然后把得到的地址（如 `https://my-mac.tailnet-xxxx.ts.net`）写进设置文件的 `publicUrl`。之后审批消息（包括转发到 IM 的审批卡片）里的实时画面链接会用这个地址，在手机上点开就能看和接管。 > 风险：虚拟机的 web 服务本身没有鉴权。`tailscale serve` 只对你 tailnet 里的设备开放；不要用 `tailscale funnel`、端口转发或任何公网隧道直接暴露 18080。 ## 五、配置 桌面版拿不到终端环境变量（只能用 `launchctl setenv` 设置），推荐写设置文件 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.json`，改完重启 dsh： ```json { "mounts": ["/Users/你/Projects/a", "/Users/你/Projects/b"], "memory": "6G", "cpus": 4 } ``` | 设置项 / 环境变量 | 默认值 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `mounts` / `DSH_COMPUTER_MOUNTS` | 自动（见第三节） | 固定共享的文件夹；环境变量用 `:` 分隔（Windows 用 `;`） | | `memory` / `cpus` | `4G` / `2` | 虚拟机资源上限 | | `publicUrl` / `DSH_COMPUTER_PUBLIC_URL` | 空 | 从别的设备访问虚拟机 web 服务的地址（见第四节），用于审批消息和状态接口 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` | `18080` | 虚拟机服务在本机的端口（仅监听 127.0.0.1）；只能用环境变量设置 | | `image` / `DSH_COMPUTER_IMAGE` | `ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest` | 虚拟机镜像 | | `backend` / `DSH_COMPUTER_BACKEND` | `auto` | `microsandbox` 或 `docker` | | `DSH_COMPUTER_GATE` | `risky` | `off` 不拦截；`risky` 拦危险命令和敏感浏览器动作；`browser` 每个浏览器动作都审批 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PRESET` | `computer` | `computer-auto` 关闭审批，只建议在虚拟机里没有重要登录态时用 | ## 六、维护 插件自带的 msb 命令在 dsh 配置目录里（桌面版如下）： ```bash MSB=~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@superradcompany/microsandbox-darwin-arm64/bin/msb $MSB list # 虚拟机状态 $MSB exec -u gem dsh-computer -- bash # 进入虚拟机 $MSB stop dsh-computer # 停机（下次 dsh 启动自动唤醒） $MSB rm -f dsh-computer # 删除虚拟机；若有快照，下次启动从最近的快照恢复 $MSB snapshot list --group dsh-computer ``` 每次共享新文件夹都会留下一个磁盘快照（`~/.microsandbox/snapshots/dsh-computer/`）。快照是链式的，后一个依赖前一个，不能单独删除；每次增加约 15–20MB。虚拟机被误删时，插件下次启动会从最新快照恢复。要回收空间只能整体重置：`$MSB rm -f dsh-computer` 后删除整个快照目录，虚拟机里的状态会一起清空。 ## 七、出问题时 插件把每次虚拟机操作写进 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log`。把最后 50 行发出来即可： ```bash tail -n 50 ~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log ``` | 现象 | 处理 | |---|---| | 日志里有“本机虚拟化不可用” | Windows：管理员执行 `Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName HypervisorPlatform -All` 和 `bcdedit /set "{current}" hypervisorlaunchtype auto`，然后重启 | | 镜像下载很慢或失败 | 确认系统代理可用，或用 `image` 换成能访问的镜像源 | | 浏览器工具报错，bash 正常 | 等一分钟；插件会自动清理浏览器锁文件并重启浏览器 | | agent 命令长时间无输出 | 看日志是否停在 `restore` 或 `pull` | ## 八、已知限制 - Mac 休眠时虚拟机暂停；真正 7×24 常驻需要一直开着的机器。 - 本机端口没有鉴权：`127.0.0.1:18080` 只对本机开放，但本机其他程序都能访问。不要在虚拟机里登录高价值账号。 - 浏览器登录后约 30–45 秒才把 cookie 写盘，立刻共享新文件夹或重启可能丢失刚完成的登录。 - 共享文件夹以外的虚拟机文件（如 `/home/gem`），dsh 的文件读写工具看不到，只能通过命令访问。 - 一个 dsh 配一台虚拟机，还没有“每个会话一台”。 - Docker 后端（Intel Mac）不支持自动共享新文件夹，需要在设置里写 `mounts` 后执行 `docker rm -f dsh-computer`。 - Windows 只验证到虚拟化检测，桌面版完整流程未验证。 ## 九、开发：界面部分 界面代码在 `ui/`，必须用 dsh 官方仓库的 tsdown 预设编译。把 `ui/` 放进官方仓库的 `packages/client/dsh-computer-ui/`，执行 `pnpm install --filter "dsh-computer..."`，然后在该目录运行 `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noCheck && npx tsdown`，把生成的 `lib/client.js` 复制到本插件的 `lib/`。虚拟机端口固定读 18080；改了 `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` 时，标签页暂时仍连 18080。 ## 十、审计日志与状态接口 **审计日志** `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`，每行一条 JSON，超过 10MB 轮转为 `.1`： | `kind` | 何时记录 | 主要字段 | |---|---|---| | `exec` / `terminal` | 每个在虚拟机里启动的进程 | `argv`、`cwd` | | `tool` | 每次 bash 或虚拟机工具调用结束（被拒绝的审批也在这里，`ok: false`） | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`ok`、`error` | | `approval-asked` | 审批闸门要求审批 | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`reason` | | `mount` | 共享 / 取消共享文件夹 | `action`、`dir`、`mounts` | | `status` | 虚拟机状态变化 | `state`、`error` | **状态接口**（给同一 dsh 里的其他插件用，例如 [dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)）：注入 `dshComputer` 服务后， ```js ctx.dshComputer.status() // { state: 'starting' | 'shell-only' | 'ready' | 'remounting' | 'error', // backend, liveViewUrl, publicLiveViewUrl, mounts, error } const stop = ctx.dshComputer.onStatus((snapshot) => { /* 状态变化时调用 */ }) ``` `dshComputer.audit(entry)` 也可以被其他插件用来往同一份审计日志里追加记录。

# dsh-gitea-search

Cross-repository code search for DeepSeek Harness over a **local mirror** of a self-hosted
[Gitea](https://gitea.io) / [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org) instance.

Self-hosted Gitea usually ships with the server-side code index **disabled**: the web UI and the API
cannot search file contents at all. This plugin mirrors every repository the token can read into a
local bare mirror, runs `git grep` over all of them on every branch, and exposes the results to the
model as three MCP tools (`mcp__gitea_search__*`). Searching and reading never touch the network.

- `search_gitea` — file contents / file paths / commit messages, across all repositories and branches
- `read_gitea_file` — one file from the mirror, without cloning
- `list_gitea_repos` — what is in the mirror, optionally filtered

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x
- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` and `git` (the only runtime dependencies)
- A self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo instance
- A **read-only** API token (Gitea scopes `read:repository` and `read:user`) for syncing a private instance
- Disk space proportional to the repositories you mirror

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-gitea-search
```

`--profile` is required. The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` installs the
dependency, appends the bundle to the profile, and inserts the MCP client row for you — no YAML to
write. If the profile runs without configuration hot reload, restart `dsh` after installing; the
tools then appear as `mcp__gitea_search__search_gitea`, `mcp__gitea_search__read_gitea_file` and
`mcp__gitea_search__list_gitea_repos`.

The bundle starts the MCP server with `npx -y dsh-gitea-search mcp` (the package is distributed
prebuilt on npm, so no build permission is needed). Installing from a git checkout instead? Point
the row at `node <path>/bin/mcp-server.mjs` yourself — see the troubleshooting section.

## Configure

The MCP client **scrubs the ambient environment** before it spawns the server, so values exported
in your shell do not reach it automatically. The bundle patch re-exports the variables explicitly
(`!!js process.env.GITEA_* ?? ''`), which means the source is the environment of the **dsh process**
itself — a systemd `Environment=` entry, or the shell that launched `dsh`.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `GITEA_MIRROR_DIR` | `~/.local/share/gitea-search/mirror` | where the bare mirrors live |
| `GITEA_BASE_URL` | — | Gitea/Forgejo base URL, **required by `sync`** |
| `GITEA_TOKEN` | — | read-only API token, required by `sync` against a private instance |
| `GITEA_OWNER` | all readable repos | comma-separated owners (users/orgs) to mirror |
| `GITEA_MAX_RESULTS` | `200` | hard cap on records returned by `search_gitea` (max 1000) |
| `GITEA_MAX_SEARCH_BYTES` | `131072` | total output budget for one search |
| `GITEA_MAX_LINE_BYTES` | `2000` | per-line cap; longer lines are truncated in place with a marker |
| `GITEA_MAX_READ_BYTES` | `60000` | per-file read cap |
| `GITEA_JOBS` / `GITEA_SYNC_JOBS` | `6` | parallel repositories during search / sync |
| `GITEA_TIMEOUT_MS` | `120000` | per git invocation timeout |

To change a value later, either export it for the `dsh` process, or override the row in your own
profile `cordis.patch.yml` by `id` (`gitea-search`) — note that an override **replaces the whole
`config` value**, so restate every key you want to keep.

## Build the mirror

```sh
export GITEA_BASE_URL=https://gitea.example.com
export GITEA_TOKEN=...            # read-only token
npx -y dsh-gitea-search sync      # first sync, then keep it fresh
```

`sync` enumerates every repository the token can read through the Gitea HTTP API and mirrors each
one (`git clone --mirror`, then `git remote update --prune`). The mirror is a plain directory of
bare repositories: `<mirror>/<owner>/<repo>.git`, or flat `<mirror>/<repo>.git` if you mirror a
single owner by hand. A cron entry or systemd timer keeps it fresh — examples are in
[docs/MANUAL.md](docs/MANUAL.md).

## Command line

The same engine ships as a CLI: `dsh-gitea-search search <pattern> [-p|-m|-E|-s|-w|-l|-c] [-r repo] [-b branch] [-A] [-n N] [--json]`,
plus `repos`, `read <repo> <path> [--ref]`, `sync [--transport https|ssh]`, `mirror` and `mcp`.
Run `dsh-gitea-search --help` for the full option list.

## Honest boundaries

- The search surface is the mirror: only content **already pushed to the server** is searchable;
  local, unpushed work is not.
- Matching is literal by default (case-insensitive), regular expressions on request — this is a
  grep, not a semantic or vector search.
- The mirror refreshes only when you schedule `sync`; the plugin never triggers it on its own.
- Results are deliberately bounded (per record, per line, per call, per read) so a single minified
  file cannot flood the model context.

## Privacy and security

- `sync` is the only networked step. The token goes to the Gitea API in an `Authorization` header
  and to `git` through `GIT_ASKPASS` — never on a command line, never in a log (git output is
  redacted before logging).
- Search and read operate **only on the local mirror**.
- File reads validate the ref and path, and invoke `git show --end-of-options`, so a crafted ref
  cannot be used as a git option (an arbitrary-file-write vector).
- The token is your responsibility: store it where your other secrets live, and revoke it when
  you stop using the mirror.

## Troubleshooting

- **Tools never appear.** With `failOnStartupError: true` a failed MCP connection makes the row fail
  to load while the harness still starts. Look for `gitea-search` in the `dsh` log. Common causes:
  `npx` cannot reach the registry (offline host — install from a git checkout instead), or on
  Windows `npx` may need to be written `npx.cmd` in the row.
- **Tools say "no repositories under …".** The mirror is missing or `GITEA_MIRROR_DIR` points
  elsewhere — run `sync` once, then check `dsh-gitea-search mirror`.
- **Slow first search.** A cold search over a large mirror can exceed the 60s MCP default, so the
  bundle already sets `toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000`. Narrow with `repo`, use `mode: "path"` or
  `files_only` to probe first.

## Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-gitea-search
```

Remove the mirror directory and revoke the token afterwards.

## Compatibility

Verified on a clean test machine (Node 24, Debian slim container) for each version below: bundle
installed with `dsh plugin add`, the profile layer resolved with **no schema diagnostics**, the
22-test suite green, and an MCP smoke run against a synthetic mirror (a 190 KB single-line blob and
a >64 KB CJK file) with no U+FFFD and the output guard intact.

| DSH version | Published | Install | Layer (`--dump-config`) | Schema diagnostics | Tests | MCP smoke |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (`latest`, `next`) | 2026-09-29 | ok | ok | none | 22/22 | ok |
| `0.2.1-alpha.3` (`alpha`) | 2026-10-14 | ok | ok | none | 22/22 | ok |
| `0.2.1-alpha.2` | 2026-10-09 | ok | ok | none | 22/22 | ok |
| `0.2.1-alpha.1` | 2026-10-03 | ok | ok | none | 22/22 | ok |

The bundle declares an `engines.dsh` range as documentation; DSH gates installation by
`peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, which this configuration-only bundle does not declare,
so it installs on any `0.2.x` runtime.

## License

MIT

--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: A daily Token-usage heatmap for the DSH settings page. Aggregated entirely from local session logs; no external requests and no separate usage ledger. ｜ DSH 设置中的每日 Token 用量热力图，数据完全取自本机会话日志，不发起外部请求，亦无需另行记录用量。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-heatmap

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A **daily token-usage heatmap** that adds a "Token usage" section to the DSH settings page. One cell per day; theme-aware greyscale indicates relative usage.

All data is derived from DSH's own local session logs. **No external network requests and no separate usage ledger.**

> **Privacy**: this plugin makes no outbound requests. Session logs are read on the local machine only, and the aggregated result is served to your local DSH page. The repository contains no personal data or credentials.

## Design highlights

- **A native settings section, not an overlay.** The component registers into the `settings.section` slot and renders React elements only. It does not append to `document.body`, does not replace the application root, and imports no Harness client package. It therefore occupies the settings sidebar alongside the built-in sections rather than floating above the application. See [Implementation notes](#implementation-notes).
- **Local data only, single source of truth.** No data leaves the machine and no additional ledger is required: every figure is derived from the session logs DSH already writes.
- **The session log format is parsed explicitly.** Concatenated zstd frames, replayed `seq` values and truncated tail frames are each handled as distinct cases. A single-pass decompression retains only the first frame of a multi-frame log and therefore under-reports usage. See [Data source](#data-source).
- **Colour levels remain readable at both ends of the scale.** The four metrics differ by orders of magnitude, so levels are derived from **quantiles of the local data set** (25th/50th/75th percentiles) rather than fixed thresholds. Cache reads frequently account for the majority of a day — 99% in the screenshots below — which is why `Input+output` is provided as a separate metric.
- **Brightness is reserved for days with recorded usage.** Days without usage occupy the lowest visual level, so an otherwise empty grid remains visually neutral and days with usage are distinguishable at a glance. This carries an accessibility benefit as well: the encoding never relies on colour hue.
- **Selection and expansion are separate states.** Collapsing a day's details retains its selection outline on the heatmap; selecting another day switches the details directly; `Esc` collapses first and clears the selection second. Reading a sequence of days therefore requires no intermediate close step.
- **Host integration for theme and language.** Colours are drawn from host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), and all visible text is registered through `ctx.locale.register`, so an application language change re-renders the section. Number units are localized as well (`万`/`亿` in Chinese, `K`/`M`/`B` in English).
- **Regression tests rather than claims.** Five self-test entry points cover frame parsing, deduplication, caching, weekly boundaries, client rendering and route registration. See [Layout](#layout).

## Screenshots

> **Note on screenshot currency.** The images below predate **v0.4.1** and have not been re-captured since. Two UI changes introduced in v0.4.1 are therefore not visible in them:
>
> 1. **Empty-day cells render darker.** Previously, a day without recorded usage was drawn at a mid-level grey, close to the lowest usage level; such cells now occupy the dimmest level, reserving the brightness range for days with usage.
> 2. **Collapsing a day retains its selection.** Selecting the same date again collapses only the detail body; the selection outline remains on the heatmap and the collapsed row carries an expand control.
>
> The textual descriptions throughout this document reflect the current behaviour.

### Half-year heatmap and compact tooltip

Open Settings → **Token usage**. The default range is six months. Choose total, input+output, cache read or output, and switch between daily and weekly views. The range selector offers six months or a full year; the year is split into two rows.

Hover a date cell to display three lines: the date (YYYY-MM-DD), the selected metric's Token count, and “Click to view details”. The example below shows 2026-10-13 with a total of 117,405,946 Token. Selecting the cell displays that day's breakdown below the heatmap. The outline indicates hover or selection; today's cell has no default highlight. Cells with no recorded usage remain at the dimmest level, so the brightness range is reserved for days with usage.

![English half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-en.png)

### Inline daily details and Token composition

Selecting a date displays its details inline below the heatmap, without navigating away from the page. A single-line hint above the footnote indicates the interaction until a date is selected. Selecting the same date again collapses the detail body while retaining the selection outline on the heatmap, so the selected date remains identifiable; the collapsed row provides an expand control. Selecting a different date switches the details directly, with no intermediate collapse step. For keyboard users, `Esc` on a focused cell collapses the details, and a second press clears the selection. All filters remain available throughout.

Details include the total, input, output, cache reads and calls, plus cache writes when present. The grayscale bar shows each component's share by Token count. The October 13, 2026 example shows 117,405,946 Token, with cache reads accounting for 99.09%. These are screenshot examples; your statistics come from your local logs.

![English daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-en.png)

### Chinese interface

Labels, months, dates and number units follow the host language. The same daily total appears as “1.17 亿” in Chinese and “117.41M” in English.

![Chinese half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-zh.png)

![Chinese daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-zh.png)

## Features

- Default half-year range (26 weeks); full year uses two rows (27 + 26 weeks), each with month labels
- Cells capped at 20px with 4px gaps, sized to the container to avoid horizontal scrollbars
- **Daily / Weekly** views: daily levels or one shared level per natural week; Sunday–Saturday, future dates empty
- **Four metrics**: total / input+output / cache read / output, rendered in theme-aware grayscale
- Hover or focus shows the cell's date, the selected metric's Token count and a click hint; weekly counts are labeled
- Click a date for inline daily details below the heatmap: total, input, output, cache reads, calls, and nonzero cache writes; weekly cells open their actual day
- Selecting the selected date again collapses the detail body while retaining its selection outline; an expand control and `Esc` both collapse, and selecting another date switches without an intermediate collapse
- Proportional Token composition bar with percentages and an empty state
- Approximately 600ms diagonal entrance without delaying the summary; filters and date selection do not replay it
- Native buttons support Enter/Space and focus feedback; respects system reduced-motion preferences
- Today / this week / all-time summary; minute refresh plus refresh on visibility or focus
- Chinese/English labels, month names and number units; follows the host light/dark theme

## Data source

`<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<session>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`

The plugin reads log records containing a valid timestamp and `data.usage`:

```
inputTokens / outputTokens / cacheReadTokens / cacheWriteTokens / totalTokens
```

plus `time` (epoch milliseconds) and `data.message.source.model`. Bucketing those by local calendar day gives the daily totals.

Three details that must be handled correctly:

1. **Logs contain concatenated zstd frames** — the parser locates frame magic bytes and decompresses frames separately to retain readable frames.
2. **The same `seq` can appear more than once** (replay) — deduplicate by `seq`, otherwise a day gets inflated.
3. **A truncated frame can appear at the tail** while a session is being written — skip that frame only, never drop the whole file.

Parsed results are cached by file size, modification time and aggregation time zone. Ne
